name: Meditation Waves
summary: 🌿Meditation Waves– Breathe, Relax & Find Your Inner Calm Escape into the peaceful beauty of a starry sky with Meditation Waves, a completely hands-free, seated mindfulness experience for Meta Quest. No controllers needed—just natural hand movements. 🌹 Intuitive Visual Breathing Guides Learn when to breathe in, breathe out, and hold with three memorable visual cues: - Smell the Rose – Breathe In: Follow a moving Rose and gently inhale its imagined fragrance. - Blow Out the Candle – Breathe
